headline: Brief v2.1.2-beta — Centered Portrait & Landscape Android UI (Zero Notch / Zero Chin), Smart Hybrid Typing & Live One UI / ColorOS / MagicOS Enter Detection
bullets: Centered Portrait & Landscape Android UI (Zero Notch Crowding & Zero Bottom Chin): Native WindowInsets cutout/system-bar handling keeps Brief clear of camera notches, eliminates the bottom chin, and centers Welcome & Onboarding cleanly in both portrait and landscape on phones & tablets.

Smart Hybrid Typing + Live OEM Enter / Search Detection: Automatically combines fresh-node input, physical on-screen keyboard tapping, and paste fallback while scanning the live keyboard window to locate and tap the exact Search / Enter / Go / Send button across Samsung One UI, Oppo/Realme ColorOS, Honor MagicOS & Gboard.

Full Multi-Step Vision Across All 4 AIs (Fastest & Strongest Models): Fixed strict turn-alternation merging on Claude, Gemini, OpenAI & OpenRouter and exposed live [KEYBOARD_ENTER_KEY] coordinates + press_enter tool to every model.
Global 1-Tap Update to v2.1.2-beta: Automatically notifies all Windows, Linux, and Android phones/tablets to update straight over v2.1.1-beta and earlier.
